_source: SAP article.ws GET_DETAILS, one call per SKU, guest browser session. 41/41 returned, 0 errors, every one priced. Companion to klapp-fixings.json, which holds the base -> fixings/plates mapping.
_note: A Montageplatte states 'ohne Befestigungsmaterial, Zubehör: Befestigungsmaterial siehe 4711 187 - 190' — the plate needs screws too. That is why the Montageplatte row comes FIRST and the Befestigungsmaterial row second (Reji, 2026-08-22).
_images: Paths are the SAP-served ones, read from the API, never constructed. Three fixings (4711 396/398/297) have no image at all; two Hewi LifeSystem plates carry SPACES in the filename ('/multimedia/Web/PS1/4711 383.446.000.png') and must be URL-encoded before fetching.

_rueckenstuetze: 6 anchors added for the Rückenstütze family. 4711 290 says it outright: 'Befestigungsmaterial Hewi zu Rückenstütze'. The 1-teilig set (178/185/186) is for the back-rests that mount on a Klappgriff; the 2-teilig set (290/291/292) for the free-standing ones.
_duschhandlauf: Duschhandlauf needs NOTHING — not one of the 37 bases says 'ohne Befestigungsmaterial'. The Keuco Collection Axess rails say 'mit Befestigungsmaterial, Set Nr. 1', i.e. it is in the box. 4171 442 (Set Nr. 4) and 4171 444 (Set Nr. 7) are ALTERNATIVES for substrates where Set Nr. 1 will not hold — an upgrade, not a missing part, so they render as an OPTIONAL row that defaults to the supplied set and contributes no SAP line unless switched (Reji, 2026-08-22).
